senses.zh_definition: 阿格尼斯／艾格妮丝：女性名字，属于专有名词；具体中文译名依本人惯用写法。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name of Greek origin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Yunani.

etymology.historical_story: Agnes comes through Latin from Greek Hagne, associated with purity or chastity. The name spread widely in Christian naming traditions through Saint Agnes. Its resemblance to Latin agnus, meaning lamb, also shaped the saint's imagery. This history explains a personal name; it does not make Agnes a Malay adjective meaning pure. [Behind the Name: Agnes](https://www.behindthename.com/name/agnes/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Agnes，先想到“一个人的名字”，并把 A 写大写；词源中的“纯洁”是名字背景，不是马来语中的实际词义。
